roadworks.detail_fr: Réhabilitation et construction de 9,16 km, lancées le 13 octobre 2026 pour 18 mois. Entreprise : Shandong Construction International, supervision ACGT. Chantier actif.
roadworks.detail_en: Rehabilitation and construction of 9.16 km, launched 13 October 2026 for 18 months. Contractor: Shandong Construction International, oversight ACGT. Works active.
roadworks.source: Presse congolaise (lancement officiel, ministère des ITP)

roadworks.title_fr: Pont Ngunza — travaux à l'arrêt (av. Pierre Elengesa, vers le By-Pass)
roadworks.title_en: Pont Ngunza — works stopped (Pierre Elengesa Ave., toward the By-Pass)
roadworks.detail_fr: Travaux de modernisation à l'arrêt depuis environ 5 mois, site déserté selon la presse. Circulation difficile signalée aux abords.
roadworks.detail_en: Modernisation works stopped for about 5 months, site deserted according to press reports. Difficult traffic reported nearby.

roadworks.title_fr: Drainage presque à l'arrêt — av. Kasaï, Croix-Rouge, Bas-Congo, Bokasa
roadworks.title_en: Drainage works nearly stopped — Kasaï, Croix-Rouge, Bas-Congo, Bokasa avenues
roadworks.detail_fr: Travaux d'assainissement et de drainage pratiquement à l'arrêt dans les communes de Barumbu, Kasa-Vubu et Ngiri-Ngiri, selon des rapports de mi-octobre 2026.
roadworks.detail_en: Sanitation and drainage works practically stopped in the Barumbu, Kasa-Vubu and Ngiri-Ngiri communes, according to mid-October 2026 reports.

roadworks.detail_fr: Travaux en progression sur la liaison Masina–Limete ; un pont est prévu sur le tracé.
roadworks.detail_en: Works progressing on the Masina–Limete link; a bridge is planned on the route.

roadworks.title_fr: Points dégradés — Landu × Birmanie (Bumbu) et Libération × Landu
roadworks.title_en: Degraded spots — Landu × Birmanie (Bumbu) and Libération × Landu
roadworks.detail_fr: Sections de chaussée dégradées créant des embouteillages aux heures de pointe, signalées début octobre 2026.
roadworks.detail_en: Degraded road sections creating peak-hour jams, reported in early October 2026.

river.title_fr: Baleinières en bois interdites à partir du 15 novembre 2026
river.detail_fr: Le ministère des Transports interdit les baleinières en bois sur le fleuve Congo et l'ensemble des voies navigables dès le 15 novembre 2026 ; les armateurs disposent d'un mois pour les remplacer par des embarcations conformes.
river.detail_en: The Ministry of Transport bans wooden baleinières (whaleboats) on the Congo River and all waterways from 15 November 2026; owners have one month to replace them with compliant vessels.

river.title_fr: Le fleuve Congo déborde sur les quartiers riverains
river.title_en: Congo River overflows into riverside neighbourhoods
river.detail_fr: Après de fortes pluies, le fleuve est sorti de son lit : Kingabwa et la Cité du Fleuve (Limete) ainsi que Pompage (Ngaliema) sont inondés, et des habitants ont abandonné leurs maisons.
river.detail_en: After heavy rains, the river burst its banks: Kingabwa and Cité du Fleuve (Limete) as well as Pompage (Ngaliema) are flooded, and residents have left their homes.

river.title_fr: Beach Ngobila — le bouclier sanitaire se renforce à la traversée
river.title_en: Beach Ngobila — health screening strengthened at the crossing
river.detail_fr: Au Beach Ngobila, principal point de traversée entre Kinshasa et Brazzaville, la technologie renforce le contrôle sanitaire entre les deux capitales, selon l'OMS.
river.detail_en: At Beach Ngobila, the main crossing point between Kinshasa and Brazzaville, technology is strengthening health screening between the two capitals, according to WHO.

river.title_fr: Pont route-rail Kinshasa–Brazzaville — travaux prévus dès juin 2027
river.title_en: Kinshasa–Brazzaville road-rail bridge — works planned from June 2027
river.detail_fr: L'accord signé le 9 octobre 2026 avec Africa50 prévoit le démarrage des travaux du pont route-rail entre les deux capitales en juin 2027.
river.detail_en: Under the agreement signed on 9 October 2026 with Africa50, works on the road-rail bridge between the two capitals are planned to start in June 2027.

river.title_fr: Kwango — le bac de Popokabaka reprend après 4 ans d'arrêt
river.title_en: Kwango — Popokabaka ferry resumes after 4 years
river.detail_fr: Le trafic fluvial a repris au bac de Popokabaka, sur la rivière Kwango, après quatre ans d'interruption ; ce bac alimente le corridor de la RN16.
river.detail_en: River traffic has resumed at the Popokabaka ferry on the Kwango River after a four-year shutdown; the ferry feeds the RN16 corridor.

dataNotes.congestion: Typical pattern model by time of day (Africa/Kinshasa). When board.json carries a recent 'live' block (Google Routes sweep by scripts/live_refresh.py, key held server-side only), the page shows those live levels instead and falls back to the typical model when the block is stale or absent.
dataNotes.towers: Cell towers are fetched live by the page from OpenStreetMap via Overpass: community-mapped data, possibly incomplete.
dataNotes.roadworks: Researched from Congolese press; each item carries its source and date.
dataNotes.river: Researched from Congolese press and official/UN reports; each item carries its source, source URL and date. No live river-level or vessel feed exists for Kinshasa.
dataNotes.fuel: Official zone Ouest price set by ministerial arrêté (Ministère de l'Économie nationale / CSPPP), uniform at every station in the zone; curated in scripts/build.py (FUEL) and cross-checked against GlobalPetrolPrices' DRC page (weekly). No per-station prices exist in the DRC.
dataNotes.reports: Jam reports are shared with all visitors via the kinshasa-reports Worker (Cloudflare D1, see reports-worker/) and stay visible for 24 hours; the page also keeps the visitor's own reports on-device as a fallback record.
